name: fuzzy_match_strategy_block_anchor
notes: Block-anchor fuzzy-match strategy. Harness links the REAL C port (fuzzy_match_helpers.c::fuzzy_match_strategy_block_anchor compiled fresh, which internally uses its own seq_ratio port of difflib.SequenceMatcher.ratio); twin imports LIVE tools/fuzzy_match.py::_strategy_block_anchor (source-extracted fallback). Input encoding '<pattern>\t<content>' with literal backslash-n decoding to newlines. Coarse rung ladder per the channel_directory precedent: too-few-pattern-lines gate, per-offset anchor branches, unique-vs-multi threshold selection, <=2-line fast path, plus the match-list V value. Middle-similarity inputs are deliberately exact-duplicate (ratio 1.0) or fully disjoint (well under threshold) so the C seq_ratio port cannot drift from difflib at threshold edges.
